notes.title: Happy Lunar new year from Fall Up
notes.notes:
Fellow mates,

From January 27th to February 10th, [i]Fall Up[/i] will be part of Steam's Lunar New Year Sale. All of us at Unicellular Games extend our heartfelt wishes to our incredible Asian player community.

As we welcome the new year, we’re continuing to actively work on [i]Fall Up[/i]. Thank you for your support, and don’t forget to add our game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1835670/_/

Take a leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with our adorable Labi! You need to traverse this cartoonish world with a variety of jumps and moves, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots and reveal the secrets of this world.

Wishing you all a Happy New Year in the Year of the Snake!

The [i]Fall Up[/i] Team

notes.title: Fall Up time-limited demo available during the Chinese New Year Steam Event!
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers!

We are excited to announce that Fall Up is participating the 'Chinese New Year Event'.

During the event period, we will release a time-limited demo from Feb-7 to Feb-14, which will feature a few stages at very begining of the game. And there will be 2 modes for each stage:

1. Exploration - Try to find all the collections, 'Battery' and 'Gems' in the stages.

2. Speed Run - After obtained all the collections, the speed run mode will be unlocked, which need you pass through the stages in a limit of time.

Hop you enjoy this demo, and Happy New Year!
